top_signals.title: Chipotle’s Softening Sales Force Analyst to Throw in the Towel
top_signals.summary: A long-standing Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc. bull has moved to the sidelines, citing concern that a slow start to the fourth quarter suggests softer sales for the year ahead.

top_signals.title: Democratic socialist set to become D.C. mayor — and face Trump's pushback
top_signals.summary: Following Zohran Mamdani's election as New York City mayor, another democratic socialist is set to become mayor of Washington, D.C.
